title: 彭博分析师Catherine Lim：阿里获AI审批，成苹果在华关键伙伴
speaker: Catherine Lim

segments.en: Let's talk this through. And I guess let's start off with why these approvals actually matter for Alibaba, Catherine.
segments.zh: 我们来聊聊。首先，这些审批对阿里巴巴为什么重要？

segments.en: Well, this is a long-awaited approval. The tie-up is not new. What effectively came true really was that with the approval.
segments.zh: 这是期待已久的审批。合作本身并不新鲜，真正实现的是审批本身。

segments.en: We could see it as Beijing effectively certifying that Qwen is an AI infrastructure platform that is safe, controllable, and compliant for mass market use in China.
segments.zh: 可以看作北京方面认证了通义千问是一个安全、可控、合规的AI基础设施平台，可用于中国大众市场。

segments.en: And this is going to be important to Alibaba because it really upgrades its status in the AI hierarchy. So now global and domestic players can plug into it when they want to scale AI in China.
segments.zh: 这对阿里巴巴很重要，因为它提升了其在AI层级中的地位。现在国内外参与者都可以接入，在中国扩展AI应用。

segments.en: So while it doesn't really change Alibaba's earnings profile, it does look like it is going to be the gatekeeper for some of the foreign players like Apple in China.
segments.zh: 虽然这不会改变阿里巴巴的盈利状况，但它似乎将成为苹果等外国玩家在中国的守门人。
